13. On perusal of the plaint as well as the connected documents I find that the corresponding S.A. khatians No.221, 223, 419 and 467 were prepared in the name of one Monindra Chandra and Narayan Chandra Mondal. The contract between the parties was held on 15.05.1984 and the consideration amount was fixed at Tk.3,75,000/-. It is further contention of the plaintiff that on several occasions he went before the defendant No.1 and requested him to execute and register a sale deed in his favour after taking the remaining sum of Tk.15,000/- and lastly on 05.02.2001 when the plaintiff went to the owner Narayan, it was decided between them that on 14.02.2001 the defendant No.1 coming to the concern Hajiganj police station from his residence of Tongibari police station under Munshiganj District, taking the remaining amount of consideration will execute and register a sub-kabala deed on the following day i.e. 15.02.2001, but while the defendant did not appear according to their agreement, the plaintiff finding no other alternative instituted the original suit on 02.04.2001. It further appears from the schedule of the plaint that the land included within the deed of agreement has been specified in the schedule. In the case records it is noticed that the attorney of the defendant No.1 at first filed a written statement in which he has admitted the deed of agreement between the parties in respect of transfer of the suit land by the defendant No.1 in favour of the plaintiff. The 2nd written statement which was filed by the son of the defendant No.1 after cancellation of the power of attorney goes to show that the deed of agreement has been challenged by the subsequent attorney viz. the son (D.W.1) of the defendant No. 1. 

 During cross-examination; P.W.4 testified that in the baina-patra there is a recital, “বায়নাপত্র পাঠ করে অবগত হলাম” This witness also testified that he read over the bainapatra and in the year 1980 he obtained licence of deed writer and finding the C.S. and R.S. khatian the bainapatra was written and the stamp paper of the bainapatra was given to him by both the parties. P.W.4 categorically denied the suggestion of the defendants that the stamp paper was anti-dated. 

 During cross-examination D.W.1 testify at a stage that his father Narayan Chandra is in his residence and his name is Narayan Chandra Mondal @ Narayan Proshad Mondal. He admits that in Hajiganj police station they had business and landed property and his father obtained the suit land from his grandfather as heir. The land of suit holding corresponds to C.S. khatian No.139 in plot No.581 and in plot No.579 under khatian No.266 and in plot No.577 under khatian No.296. D.W.1 frankly conceded in his deposition that in the S.A. khatian the suit land has been recorded in the name of his father. He also admits in his cross-examination that in partition Suit No.337 of 1967 his father obtained a saham of 2.55 acres of land and prior to this; his father did not transfer his land to anybody. This witness expressed his inability to state anything about the transfer of the suit land by his father in favour of Ali Ahmed Patwary. He has admitted in his cross-examination that in the power of attorney,  which was in favour of Jitu Mia, there is a mention of the suit land and its owner is his father. D.W.1 admitted the signature of his father in the deed of agreement which was signed as "Narayan Chandra Mondal @ Proshad Chandra Mondal." 

 20. D.W.3 is Abu Taher Majumder, who is the possession witness of the defendants... This witness in his testimony in a reply to a question from the side of the plaintiff testified that the suit is for 49Y2 decimals of land and he cannot say the khatian number but the plot number is 581. He has heard that Narayan Chandra was the owner of the suit property. In another stage of his testimony this witness testified that he cannot say the total area of plot No.581 and also cannot say as to whether any other plot is included within the suit property. This D.W.3 in his deposition categorically admitted that he cannot say who possess what land of the suit khatian. 

 During cross-examination in a reply to a question D.W.4 testified that his application for becoming party to this suit was rejected by the court which was given in the name of his wife. He does not know anything about the deed of agreement between the plaintiff and Narayan Chandra and also cannot say the number of the suit khatian. He expressed his inability to state in how many khatians the suit land is situated. This witness in his testimony frankly conceded that he cannot say the area of land of each khatian and admitted in his deposition that the owner of the suit khatian was Narayan Chandra Mondal and this suit arise out of the land of Narayan Chandra and in the last portion of his cross-examination this witness testified that he cannot say the area, khatian number and plot number of the suit property.
